source.title: Northern Whig, 16 April 1924, p. 4 ("Unionists returned to power in Tyrone: Castlederg Rural Council")
source.publisher: Northern Whig (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: names and divisions read on the OCR of the Northern Whig's nomination list of 16 April 1924, checked against the Londonderry Standard of the same date

note: Nomination-day report for the sixteen electoral divisions of Castlederg rural district, one member each. Ten Unionist candidates were nominated and returned unopposed; six seats remained vacant and were filled by co-option. There was no contest and no poll. Sole nomination; returned unopposed. Returned unopposed.
